brief.subject: JRC releases Version 4 of its 2020 Global Forest Cover map
brief.headline: JRC Publishes Version 4 of 2020 Global Forest Cover Map; Cocoa Crisis May Be Easing
brief.dek: The EU's Joint Research Centre updated its 2020 forest cover map, and Barry Callebaut signals the worst of the cocoa crisis may be over.
brief.lede: The EU's Joint Research Centre has released Version 4 of its Global Forest Cover map for 2020. Teams that screen plots against forest data should note the update.

sections.heading: JRC updates 2020 forest map
bullets: Version 4 of the JRC Global Forest Cover map for 2020 is now out, so screening teams should note which version they use.
The European Commission's environment newsroom announced the release on 2026-10-19, flagging it as an official EU update.
Exporters and cooperatives should confirm which map version their geolocation checks rely on, since results may differ between versions.

sections.heading: Cocoa: worst may be past
bullets: Barry Callebaut says the cocoa crisis has likely peaked, offering cautious relief to buyers and suppliers.
APAC cocoa players still face major market shifts and challenges, so supply-chain risk has not gone away.

items.title: Creamers move beyond coffee with flavors, cold foams and café-inspired experiences
items.snippet: SPINS data shows consumers gravitating toward flavored creamers and cold foams that deliver café-inspired flavors and textures, while dairy-focused brands balance indulgence with simpler ingredient lists.

items.title: APAC cocoa trends: ‘Worst is past’, but risks remain
items.snippet: Cocoa giant Barry Callebaut says the worst of the cocoa crisis is likely over, but the APAC cocoa industry continues to navigate major market shifts and challenges
